issue.title: test_usage_config.py: 4 tests assert the shipped claude weekly:claude-fable-5 'always' default that c00964773 removed
issue.description:
Four tests in `tests/llm_provider/test_usage_config.py` fail deterministically on clean
`origin/master` (e1ba4851c) with `KeyError: 'claude'` at
`settings.config["providers"]["claude"]["windows"]["weekly:claude-fable-5"]` (line ~213).

Failing nodes:

- `test_usage_indicator_defaults_and_overrides`
- `test_usage_indicator_real_bundled_default_and_user_override_projection[empty-provider-map-keeps-bundled-exact-window]`
- `test_usage_indicator_real_bundled_default_and_user_override_projection[unrelated-provider-override-keeps-claude-defaults]`
- `test_usage_indicator_real_bundled_default_and_user_override_projection[broader-provider-default-loses-to-exact-window]`

## Root cause

`c00964773` (`feat(llm-provider): govern Claude Fable usage indicator by generic threshold`)
deliberately removed the shipped `providers.claude.windows."weekly:claude-fable-5": always`
override from `src/sase/default_config.yml` so the generic `indicator.default` threshold
governs that window. The commit added `tests/llm_provider/test_claude_fable_usage_indicator_default.py`
but did not update `test_usage_config.py`, which still asserts the removed shipped entry and
the old projected window order.

## Fix

Update the stale expectations in `test_usage_config.py` for the new shipped default (Fable is
quiet until it drops below the generic threshold) rather than loosening them. Do not restore
the `always` override: that reverts the intended product change.

## Evidence

Found while running `just check` for an unrelated change. Reproduced on a clean
`git worktree` of `origin/master` with the same venv, and with `HOME=$(mktemp -d)`, so it does
not depend on host user config. Distinct from closed `sase-10m` (window key ordering), which
this is not.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Fails on every run, including in isolation (`pytest tests/llm_provider/test_usage_config.py`),
on a clean worktree of origin/master with an empty HOME. The assertion reads a config key that
c00964773 intentionally deleted from default_config.yml, so no rerun can pass.
